## Mechanics & Rules

### Percentage Calculation Rules

- **File Creation**: +10% base completion for file structure
- **Core Functionality**: +40% for working implementation
- **Integration**: +25% for proper cross-component communication
- **Testing**: +15% for comprehensive testing coverage
- **Documentation**: +10% for complete inline and API documentation

### Update Frequency

- **Real-time**: During active development sessions
- **Milestone**: At completion of major components
- **Integration**: After successful cross-system testing
- **Quality Gates**: After passing code review and testing phases

### Characters & Symbols Usage

- **🏗️** Construction/Development in progress
- **✅** Completed and tested functionality
- **🔧** Configuration or setup tasks
- **🚀** Performance optimizations
- **🔒** Security implementations
- **🧠** Hypnosis/psychology-related features
